pages.text: The knight who always returns, and now returns to you.$(br2)Summoned with a $(l:rituals/necroturgy_ritual)Necroturgy Ritual$(): a Lord Soul on the altar, with Nightfall, an Arkenstone and two Soul Infused Ingots.$(br2)$(italic)Requires Marium's Soulslike Weaponry.$()

pages.title: As a Servant
pages.text: It brings down Obliterate, Blinding Reflection, Rupture and the Mace of Spades.$(br2)The Remnants it raises serve you too, and its Dark Sorcerers heal it; up to six of them at once.
When it falls, it leaves its soul behind. On a Dark Altar it returns once more for 500 souls.
